AbstractText.Label: Context
AbstractText.content: Unprecedented low coverage (63%) of fully vaccinated (FV) children in the recent round of national survey district level household (HH) and facility survey 4 (DLHS-4) propelled health system of Himachal Pradesh for an independent rapid assessment of FV coverage.

AbstractText.Label: Aim
AbstractText.content: The aim of the study was to assess the FV coverage among 12-23-month old children in the state.

AbstractText.Label: Settings and Design
AbstractText.content: A community-based survey with an interviewer-administered questionnaire was carried out in all 12 districts of Himachal Pradesh from September 2015 to January 2016.

AbstractText.Label: Statistical Analysis Used
AbstractText.content: Chi-square and unpaired Student's t-test along with 95% confidence intervals.

AbstractText.Label: Results
AbstractText.content: A total of 2492 children across 35,551 HHs (2.4% of state share) were surveyed with FV coverage of 98.1% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 97.5-98.6) and 86% (95% CI: 84.6-87.3) based on history and card, respectively.

AbstractText.Label: Conclusions
AbstractText.content: The reported FV coverage in the current study was observed too high in the state as reported in earlier round of the national surveys (except DLHS-4).
